ai_summary: Authum Investment & Infrastructure Ltd. announced the approval of its FY25-26 Annual Report and the re-appointment of two independent directors, ensuring governance continuity. The material impact centers on the appointment of Mr. Amit Dangi as Interim Chief Financial Officer, concurrently with his Whole-time Director role, as the company conducts a search for a permanent CFO. This interim arrangement and combined executive responsibility could signal a temporary leadership gap in a critical financial function, warranting close monitoring.
